candidate_policy: Exactly reuse all 17 prior candidates from frozen positive/conflict windows; no candidate, image or axis-scale change
arms_policy: R0 exact original REVIEW_TASK; R1 exactly three candidate/confirmation wording replacements; R2 same neutral instructions plus fixed 30-day visible observation blocks, first activity day and extended JSON output
short_target_policy: Keep exact target and short tail; allow uncertain with context, never extend target or invent measurements
output_validation: Common strict interval parser; R2 also checks every frozen block, first activity consistency and no activity in stationary/uncertain blocks. Failures remain whole-target unknown, no clipping or retry
schedule: Sorted case and candidate; cyclic rotate three arms by candidate ordinal to balance order
stage_policy: Same saved XGBoost, observed features and support mask; no retraining or thresholds
development_success_check: Relative to concurrent R0, a treatment must reduce negative-day FP while retaining all 81 reference weak days, without decreasing daily F1; report FN, coverage, failures and stage quality regardless. This is a post-diagnostic development criterion, not a confirmatory or field superiority test
cost_policy: Same image inputs, model parameters and 2048-token cap; R2 changes output length and validation burden, so token cost and failure rates need separate reporting
limits: Previously viewed synthetic development records, correlated AI-assisted labels, one weak episode and one call per target/arm; offline features. Structured evidence and schema are one combined factor, not proof of internal reasoning or causal attention. No independent, field or online warning claim
